audiospeed_oracle: CircuitPython 10.2.1 source plus MicroPython executable regression

aarch64.evidence: 6 of 744 numeric fields differ from the x86_64 reference; largest absolute deviation 1, in every case. The fields are sum(data) over a 512-byte block (256 int16 samples), so a delta of 1 is one byte off by one -- 1 LSB of int16, about -90 dBFS. Confined to multitap (5 fields) and pitchshift (1); phaser, chorus, freeverb and speed are bit-identical, as are the 16 real decoded samples on the phaser_samples line. Consistent with floating-point contraction in delay-line interpolation, not a defect.
